services.name: Escape Room
services.desc: Conveniently located in downtown Portsmouth, we offer free parking to all Portsmouth Escape Room customers. We are an entertaining indoor activity open Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Other days and times available by request. Ian Westower, a recognized antiques collector and avid traveler has been kidnapped during his latest trip abroad. The kidnappers are after a very valuable necklace hidden within his study, and the only way they will let him go is in exchange for this precious piece. The Westower family is offering a substantial reward to whomever can find the necklace in Westower's study and ensure his safe return. The catch: you only have 60 minutes to succeed.
